reviews.primary_version: VeOmni PR #779 plus merge commit d13637a1c8266c4a6b6a14a07923392e91ccbf9a
reviews.adopted_claim: For Qwen2-family multimodal ViTs, config-dependent variable-length/window metadata can be derived by a picklable host-side collator and passed as an explicit vit_metadata contract, avoiding specific GPU-forward D2H syncs while retaining a device-side fallback.
reviews.trade_off: Host-side port duplicates config-dependent layout logic, adds collator metadata/state and picklability requirements, and can move work into the input pipeline.
reviews.failure: Host/device layout drift can preserve shape yet permute tokens or reintroduce synchronization; residual rotary/mRoPE syncs remain allowlisted.
reviews.fallback: Omit precomputed metadata and run the existing device-side metadata path; require exact-logit equivalence before enabling the optimized path.
reviews.non_proof: No end-to-end training step-time, CPU collator cost, multi-node scaling, production tail latency or cross-model generalization is reported.
reviews.withdrawal_check: PR remains merged and repository public at author check; no withdrawal/revert notice on the exact event page.

reviews.adopted_claim: In HSDP gradient accumulation, reduce-scatter over the sharded dimension remains necessary per micro-step, whereas all-reduce over the replicated dimension is needed only at the last micro-step before optimizer commit.
evaluation_locators: PR #781 — Test command and before/after three-iteration logs

evaluation_boundary.runtime: VeOmni FSDP2 with offload and EP=8
evaluation_boundary.repetitions: three shown iterations, no statistical analysis

reviews.trade_off: Optimization depends on exact accumulation and replica boundaries; it reduces communication latency but not memory.
reviews.failure: Wrong final-micro-step detection, replica membership or reduction convention can leave replicas with divergent gradients while producing finite values.
reviews.fallback: Perform both reduce-scatter and replicated all-reduce on every micro-step and verify gradient/update equivalence.
reviews.non_proof: The 24:25 to 24:03 log is not accepted as a general speedup: hardware, node count, repeated runs, variance and convergence-equivalent quality are undisclosed.
reviews.withdrawal_check: PR remains merged and repository public at author check; no withdrawal/revert notice on the exact event page.

reviews.primary_version: Hy-MT2 PR #1 plus merge commit fd271bebbe493144a1f4c258cc9be07c80db5e03
method_locators: https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/Hy-MT2/pull/1.patch — scoring.py response mapping and run_eval coverage hunks
reviews.adopted_claim: When one content md5 can occur under multiple instruction languages, evaluator response joins must preserve the complete item variant identity. Hy-MT2 changes the primary key from md5 to (md5, instruction_lang), keeps md5-only lookup as an explicit compatibility fallback, and computes coverage over matched test-item identities rather than unique hashes.
evaluation_locators: PR #1 patch — scorer input adds instruction_lang
PR #1 patch — response map changes from md5 to (md5, instruction_lang)
PR #1 patch — run_eval coverage counts matched test items
reviews.trade_off: A composite key raises schema and ingestion requirements because every client must preserve instruction language. The compatibility fallback can mask missing language fields and collapse variants unless it is audited.
reviews.failure: A content-only md5 join can overwrite or attach a response from the wrong instruction language, silently mixing language slices and overstating coverage while all rows remain syntactically valid.
reviews.fallback: Use md5-only matching only after proving the hash is unique in the evaluated set or when an explicitly versioned legacy input lacks language; otherwise mark the item missing or unscorable and retain the raw response for repair.
reviews.non_proof: The patch proves the join and coverage correction mechanism only. It does not disclose the affected-row count, corrected score magnitude, benchmark-wide impact, or generalize the exact schema beyond evaluators with shared content identities.
reviews.withdrawal_check: PR remains merged and repository public at repair check; no withdrawal/revert notice on the exact event page.
